summary: refuse a what_changes path no group lists
pull_request_body: The stage job renders the Impact section of proposal.md from the paths of the task groups and compares them with nothing. The plan adds a reply-only check that refuses a What Changes item whose code span names a repository path that no group changes or creates.
why: Issue #3411: the first plan of #3379 for #3373 named `src/devops_cli/lang/en/messages.py` in What Changes, and no group listed that file, so the rendered Impact left it out and every gate accepted the plan.
what_changes: Refuse a repository path in a code span of a What Changes item that no group lists in `changes` or `creates`, in `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage_change.py`.
Add the message that names the unlisted path to `src/devops_cli/lang/en/messages.py`.
Hold a case for each rule of the check in `tests/roadmap/test_roadmap_stage_content.py`.
feasibility: `check_proposal` of `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage_change.py` takes the `StagedTree` that the job and the replay give it, so the check reads no git and no file.
`StagedTree.as_path` and `StagedTree.paths_in` of `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage_paths.py` decide whether a word is a repository path from the suffixes and the top folders of the tree.
existing_tool: The change extends the code-span path rule of `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage_paths.py`, which already reads the code spans of the group texts, so the What Changes items reuse that rule and no second grammar appears.

decisions.decision: Run the check from `check_proposal`, which holds the staged tree
decisions.reason: The stage job and the replay both call it with that tree, so the check makes no git call.

rejected.alternative: Split each What Changes item on whitespace and treat each word as a path
rejected.evidence: An item names commands and prose, such as `uv run devops ci test`, so the split refuses valid plans.

added.name: Refuse an unlisted What Changes path
added.text: The proposal check SHALL return a problem when a repository path in a code span of a What Changes item is in neither the changes nor the creates list of any task group.

scenarios.name: What Changes names a path that no group lists
scenarios.when: A proposal has a What Changes item with the code span `src/devops_cli/lang/en/messages.py`, and no group lists that path in `changes` or `creates`.
scenarios.then: `check_proposal` returns a problem that names the unlisted path.

groups.title: Refuse a What Changes path that no group lists
groups.test: a proposal that names an unlisted path in a What Changes item is refused
groups.implementation: collect the changed and created paths of the groups and refuse each What Changes path that the set does not hold

criteria.criterion: The stage check refuses a What Changes item that names a repository path that no group lists in `changes` or `creates`.
